name: viber-social-mcp
description: Viber (social): me, publish_text, publish_image. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_viber_auth_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_VIBER_AUTH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_viber_auth_token.description: Viber Channel authentication token: as the channel's super admin open the Channel info screen > Developer Tools > copy token. The Channels Post API takes it as the auth_token member of every JSON request body (https://developers.viber.com/docs/tools/channels-post-api/). A webhook must have been set once with set_webhook before posting works (status 10 webhookNotSet otherwise).

platform_mcp_viber_sender_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_VIBER_SENDER_ID
platform_mcp_viber_sender_id.description: Viber user id of a Channel SUPER ADMIN, sent as `from` ('Only the superadmins' ID should be used as the sender ID with this API'); listed under members[] with role superadmin in get_account_info.

tools.name: me
tools.description: get_account_info returns {status, status_message, Id ('pa:...'), chat_hostname (channel name), background, members[{id, name, avatar, role superadmin|admin}]}.

tools.name: publish_text
tools.description: PUBLISHES to the Viber Channel: POST /pa/post {auth_token, from (config sender_id), type: 'text', text (max 7000 characters)}; subscribers see the channel name as sender. A non-zero status (2 invalidAuthToken, 4 missingData, 10 webhookNotSet, 12 tooManyRequests) is an error result. The page does not show a /post response body; `id` is message_token when Viber returns it (null otherwise). `reply_to` is ignored (no reply parameter).

tools.name: publish_image
tools.description: PUBLISHES a picture message to the Viber Channel: {type: 'picture', text (description, 'Required. Max 768 characters' - pass text, an empty string is allowed), media (the first image_urls entry: a JPEG URL with a .jpeg extension, max 1 MB; 'Only JPEG format is supported')}. Only the first image is posted; no thumbnail is sent.
